# AFP v0.6.0 — Physical Brakes for Enterprise Agent Networks

> **"TCP governs packets. AFP governs optimizers."**
> **「TCP 治理数据包，AFP 治理优化器。」**

---

## English

### Overview

**Aegis Fabric Protocol (AFP)** is a Kubernetes-native **Consequence Persistence Layer (CPL)** — an out-of-band sidecar that stops planner dead-loops, intent bursts, and recursive delegation storms **before** they become irreversible network I/O.

This release marks the **PR-6c architecture freeze**: a working PoC/demo stack, published container images, and the full **Whitepaper v2.0 Protocol Edition** (Draft v0.2) in the repository.

AFP is **complementary to semantic signaling** (e.g. ASP): signaling governs *how agents talk*; AFP governs *whether an intent may execute at all*.

### What's Included

**Data plane (L2)**
- Go sidecar with **PreFlightCheck** over Unix domain socket (~μs latency)
- **EntropyMonitor** + **ACC/FSM** kernel: PERMISSIVE / THROTTLED / ISOLATED
- Recursion depth breaker and entropy circuit breaker
- GovernanceHeader ingress/egress for inter-node mesh (open-exchange profile)

**Application layer (L1)**
- Python SDK (`afp_sdk`) with gRPC IPC
- LangGraph `@afp_governed_node` decorator with graceful annotate-on-block

**Control plane (L3)**
- `AFPClusterPolicy` CRD + Operator + ConfigMap hot-reload
- Policy Controller with **`StreamPolicyUpdates`** gRPC stream
- **Kill Switch** overlay via `policyctl` (<1s fleet clamp)
- Dual-source policy merge: durable ConfigMap law + runtime injunction
- mTLS policy stream, SA TokenReview, revision replay, status writeback, delete propagation

**Distribution**
- GHCR images (auto-published on `main`):
  - `ghcr.io/filthymudblood/aegis-fabric-sidecar`
  - `ghcr.io/filthymudblood/aegis-fabric-operator`
  - `ghcr.io/filthymudblood/afp-demo-agent`
- One-command demo: `make kind-quickstart`

### Empirical Results

Monte Carlo open-mesh (500 nodes · 5% malicious · 100 epochs · 1,000 runs):

| Mode | Mean survival at T=100 |
|------|--------------------------|
| Baseline | ~0.4% |
| AFP | **100%** |

Reproduce: `go run ./cmd/simulator/`

### Quick Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/FilthyMudblood/aegis-fabric.git && cd aegis-fabric
make kind-quickstart
```

### Known Limitations

- Governance header crypto attestation uses placeholders
- P2P gossip transport not yet wired
- Entropy monitor uses simplified/mock cgroup providers in some paths
- Ingress → agent payload forwarding incomplete
- **PoC/demo grade** — see [ROADMAP.md](https://github.com/FilthyMudblood/aegis-fabric/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) for Phase 3+

## 中文

### 概述

**Aegis Fabric Protocol（AFP）** 是 Kubernetes 原生的**后果持久层（CPL）**——伴生 Sidecar 在意图变成不可逆网络 I/O **之前**，掐灭规划死循环、意图爆发与递归委派风暴。

本版本对应 **PR-6c 架构冻结**：可运行的 PoC/演示栈、已发布的容器镜像，以及仓库内完整的**白皮书 v2.0 协议版**（草稿 v0.2）。

AFP 与语义信令协议（如 ASP）**互补**：信令管 *Agent 怎么对话*；AFP 管 *这个意图能不能物理执行*。

### 本版本包含

**数据面（L2）** — PreFlightCheck、EntropyMonitor、ACC/FSM、递归/熵断路器、GovernanceHeader

**应用层（L1）** — Python SDK、LangGraph `@afp_governed_node`

**控制面（L3）** — CRD、Operator、Policy Controller 策略流、Kill Switch、双源策略合并、mTLS

**分发** — GHCR 镜像 + `make kind-quickstart`
